_comment: Prototype fixes after the stored-prototype rounds (2026-11-14); replay after names/protos_all_dlls.json with tools/apply_logic_protos.py names/protos_fix_1.json. sputActor_GetActorHandle takes the actor only: its callers push lua_pushusertag's tag before the call, which the inferred `int tag` took (sputActor_SetSelectedActor then passed unaff_retaddr). Res_Touch and Str_ToLower return void: no caller uses the value, and what is in EAX at their end is whatever their last callee left (Res_MoveToFront is void, Str_ToLower ends with the terminator). Palette_FromFloatTable's double is at [esp+0x10]: Ghidra's __cdecl model aligned it to 0x14, so Palette_ApplyGamma's push of the table entry was read as the -4 dword plus the return address (\"stack\": custom storage). TextObject_New takes (ctx, text) only: the body reads two stack arguments; the inferred durationMs / flags came from caller pushes for later calls (unaff_ registers in sputText_CreateActorText and the Lua text functions).
